fullContentHtml:
UP PGT 2022 Student Waiting Lists - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pardesh Secondary Education Services Selection Board (UPSESSB) has released the Student Waiting Lists for selection to the posts of PGT (Post Graduate Teacher the Advt. No. 02/2022. The vacancy came in the year 2022 and it took almost two years to conduct the written examination for the prescribed posts. The Interview examination was conducted on 15-27 June 2026. Candidates who qualified for this exam can download their UP PGT Final Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 09 June 2022
  • Application Start Date : 09 June 2022
  • Last Date : 10 July 2022
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 13 July 2022
  • Form Submit Last Date : 16 July 2022
  • Exam Date : 09 – 10 May 2026
  • Exam City Details : 30 April 2026
  • Admit Card : 06 May 2026
  • Answer Key : 12 May 2026
  • Result : 02 June 2026
  • Interview Schedule : 15-27 June 2026
  • Interview Letter : 05 June 2026
  • Final Result : 07 July 2026
  • Student Waiting Lists : 26 August 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC Candidates : Rs.750/-
  • EWS Candidates : Rs. 650
  • SC Candidates : Rs.450/-
  • SC Candidates : Rs.250/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs.375/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
